turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) for 1 to 30 September 2026 was 12,582.75 EUR; the metric is revenue of non-cancelled orders by order date minus partner returns by return date, so returns are the ones recorded in September, not only those of September orders. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
